name: switchboard
description: KOZMOS Switchboard: an MCP observatory sidebar. Every MCP server in the session with its tools, calls, errors, average and p95 latency, last call and a status lamp (healthy, erroring, idle, busy); servers with no calls yet too, and per-tool rows on expand. On the desktop a patch bay with glowing cables to the active servers. /switchboard toggles it.

autoOpen.title: Open on start
autoOpen.description: Open the Switchboard sidebar when a session starts (where the layout docks panes).
